The change does raise the LRU limits, but it does so to a measured 8 192 entries rather than to an unbounded / even larger size. The constant `_CALLABLE_CACHE_SIZE = 8192` is chosen because “Large apps have a few thousand distinct dependency callables; entries are tiny.” That is a moderate increase over the 1 024 limit introduced in #16049, enough to cover a few thousand distinct callables without re-introducing a noticeable memory cost. It is not the unbounded/even-larger bump that was considered and rejected.
